NIGHT-REHEARSAL-01.goal: After the watchdog install handoff, run one fresh REHEARSAL_STUB night through the installed LaunchAgent and night-driver courier before any real plan, then send the stage-1 email before the first diagnostic plan is armed.

fences.rule: Ed's standing NO overrides any armed night; the arming email precedes arming (cold gate coldgate-e10 (b))

Receipt classes are honest: REHEARSAL_STUB can never carry verdict GO; TRANSACTION_PACK cannot GO from stage-1 code; DIAGNOSTIC_NO_PACK records C2 as NOT_APPLICABLE with basis no_pack_by_design, never PASS

Zero-agent fence unchanged: the agent census (/usr/bin/pgrep -lf 'codex, claude, or t3 (alternation)' exit exactly 1, empty stdout) is the driver's first act and repeats every 30 s during the chain; any hit refuses or aborts the night

acceptance: cold_start.json recorded and COURIER_DEADLINE_S set from its median
A REHEARSAL_STUB result on a night-results branch produced by a launchd-started driver (not a shell-started one), with verdict REHEARSAL_ONLY
The courier email for that rehearsal is in Ed's inbox (message id recorded)
The stage-1 plan email (first armed date; launches without Ed's hand unless he replies NO) is sent before install_night_agent.sh arms a DIAGNOSTIC_NO_PACK plan

A rehearsal with the agents installed the MORNING BEFORE the armed night, so the pre-night 07:00 dead-man firing is observed standing down without writing anything but a log line (coldgate-d1 R-7 amendment)
After WATCHDOG-INSTALL-01, one fresh REHEARSAL_STUB night fires through the night driver's own courier before any real plan is armed
